INSTRUCTIONS: Copy this file, rename it, tune parameters.
Reference in a run file as: trackers/GNN/my_GNN
This file contains GNN-SPECIFIC algorithm tuning only.
Shared environment params (volume, beta, Pd, filter) live in:

PARAM_DOCS.tracker_type: GNN | JPDA | TOMHT — which tracking algorithm to use.
PARAM_DOCS.filter_model: CV = straight line assumption. IMM = handles turns (recommended).
PARAM_DOCS.gate: Association gate size. Larger=more permissive. 30-120 typical.
PARAM_DOCS.far_gnn: False alarm rate for GNN score logic. 1e-6 typical.
PARAM_DOCS.confirm_threshold: Score to confirm a track. Higher=slower confirm but fewer false tracks. 5-20 typical.
PARAM_DOCS.delete_threshold: Score below which track is deleted. More negative=tracks survive longer. -3 to -10 typical.
